text: Diverged means moved apart in different directions. Here, two towns that are close together ended up with very different futures.
Tranquil means calm, quiet, and peaceful. Here, Nanporo is a quiet town away from the big city.
Palpable means so strong you can almost feel it. Here, the happy hope in Nanporo is easy to sense.
A fate is what finally happens to someone or something. Here, it means what became of each town.
Hokkaido is the northernmost of Japan's four main islands, known for cold, snowy winters.
Nanporo is a small town in Hokkaido whose population is growing again.
Yubari is a town in Hokkaido that used to mine coal and has lost most of its people.
Sapporo is the biggest city on Hokkaido and its regional capital.
A commuter town is a place where many people live but travel to a bigger nearby city for work.
The native population means people who were born in a place, not those who moved in from somewhere else.
Coal mining is digging coal out of the ground, which people burn for energy.
A hub is a central place where a lot of activity or travel meets. Here, the old mining center.
Bankrupt means a person, company, or town has run out of money and cannot pay what it owes.
A peak is the highest point. Here, it is the time when the town had the most people.
Contrasting means very different from each other when compared.
A trajectory is the path something follows over time. Here, how each town's story is heading.
Demographic means about the makeup of a population, such as how many people there are and how old they are.
Shrinkage means getting smaller. Here, fewer and fewer people living in a place.
To tick up means to rise by a small amount. Here, the population went up a little again.
A municipality is a town or city with its own local government.
Immigration means people moving into a country from another country to live.
Substantial means large enough to matter.
A gaggle is a loud, loose group, like geese. Here, a bunch of children.
Clambering means climbing in a clumsy, eager way using hands and feet.
A vaulted ceiling is a high, arched ceiling that makes a room feel tall and open.
Adjoining means right next to and connected with.
To peruse is to look through something, such as books, slowly and with interest.
Structural advantages are built-in strengths, like a good location, that do not depend on one plan.
An initiative is a new plan or program started to solve a problem.
Capaciousness means having lots of room. Here, the wide open space of the countryside.
An orbit is a path around something. Here, it means being close enough to be pulled into the big city's economy.
An incentive is a reward that encourages people to do something, such as move to a town.
Sustained means kept up for a long time without stopping.
Prefectural means belonging to a prefecture, a large region of Japan like a state.
A land bank is a collection of unused land held by the government so it can be sold or used later.
A plot is a small piece of land, often meant for building a house.
A steep discount means a price lowered by a lot.
Anxiety is a worried, nervous feeling. Here, many people in Japan were worried about high rice prices.
The ground floor is the floor at street level.
Brisk means quick and lively. Brisk business means many customers.
A baby boom is a time when many more babies than usual are born.
A competitive dynamic means places are in a contest for the same people, so one wins when another loses.
A relic is something left over from an earlier time.
Restructuring means changing how something is organized, often to save money.
Halted means stopped.
To lament is to say you are sad or sorry about something.
An entrepreneur is a person who starts a business.
An outflow is people or things moving out. Here, young people leaving.
A prospect is a chance that something will happen.
Revitalisation means bringing new life and energy back to a place.
Compact means packed closely into a small space. Here, a town where people live closer together.
Inevitable means certain to happen and impossible to avoid.
A decline is a slow fall, such as fewer people over time.
